lines.text: و امردان و کثرت باد و فتنه در بعضی بقعه ها و جمع امدن مردم در زمین عراق عرب و امدن
lines.en: and beardless youths, and an abundance of wind, and sedition in some regions, and the gathering of people in the land of Arab Iraq, and the coming of

lines.text: جنوح و ایلچیان و خبرهای مختلف و نیکی حال دبیران و اگر زهره مستعلی بود میان
lines.en: armies and envoys, and various news, and the good condition of scribes. And if Venus is ascendant, between

lines.text: اهل عراق و ارمنیه حرب افتد و توسط باران و رعد و برق باشد و اگر عطارد مستعلی بود
lines.en: the people of Iraq and Armenia war will break out, and there will be moderate rain, thunder, and lightning. And if Mercury is ascendant,

lines.text: ملک بابل بهزیمت شود و نیکی کشت بود و مرگ اهل فارس نباشد (مقارنه سفلیین
lines.en: the king of Babylon will be defeated, and there will be good crops, and there will not be death among the people of Fars. (The conjunction of the two inferior planets

lines.text: در مثلثه خاکی) دلالت کند بر بسیاری بیع و شری اطعمه و حیوانات و شیرینیها و جامهها
lines.en: in the earthy triplicity) indicates much buying and selling of food, animals, sweets, and clothes,

lines.text: و ارزانی و فراخی و نیکی کشت و زرع و امد و شد کاروانها و مسافران و افتادن اخبار
lines.en: and cheapness and abundance, and good crops and agriculture, and the coming and going of caravans and travelers, and the occurrence of news

lines.text: خوش و بسیاری خصومت و عداوت و بدحالی وکلا و متصرفان و ظهور مشعبدان و
lines.en: that is good, and much hostility and enmity, and the bad condition of deputies and administrators, and the appearance of jugglers and

lines.text: بازیگران و بودن سرما و کمی باران در وقت و جاهلی کردن عامه نزد سلاطین و فرماندهان
lines.en: actors, and the presence of cold and little rain in its season, and the ignorance of the common people before sultans and commanders,

lines.text: و بهتان و دروغ و آشکارا شدن حیلها و فسق و تغییر هوا و خشکی کشت و زرع و روائی
lines.en: and calumny and lies, and the manifestation of tricks and immorality, and the changing of the weather, and the dryness of crops and agriculture, and the currency of

lines.text: کار عملداران و تجار و اهل صنایع (اگر در ثور بود) دلالت کند بر رونق تجار و اهل
lines.en: the work of officials, merchants, and artisans. (If it is in Taurus) it indicates the prosperity of merchants and the people of

lines.text: اسواق و تیزی بازارها و خیر در معاملات و امدن اخبار نيك و سلامت از تفاهات و
lines.en: the markets, and the briskness of the bazaars, and good in transactions, and the coming of good news, and safety from trivialities, and

lines.text: ارزانی و رسیدن مسافران و فرح فضلا و ارباب دواوین و بارندگی نافع و غزو اهل
lines.en: cheapness, and the arrival of travelers, and the joy of the learned and the masters of the diwans, and beneficial rain, and the raiding of the people of

lines.text: ارمنیه با اهل روم و رطوبة و اعتدال هوا و بادهای خوش و فرح وزرا و کتاب و زنان
lines.en: Armenia against the people of Rome, and moisture and the moderation of the weather, and pleasant winds, and the joy of viziers, scribes, and women,

lines.text: و خصومت میان دبیران و اهل ادب اگر زهره مستعلی بود مرگ و قحط باشد و کمی باران
lines.en: and hostility among scribes and the people of literature. If Venus is ascendant, there will be death and famine, and little rain,

lines.text: و کمی طعام و اگر عطارد مستعلی بود اهل ارمنیه قصد رومیان کنند و جستن بادها و
lines.en: and little food. And if Mercury is ascendant, the people of Armenia will intend [to attack] the Romans, and the blowing of winds, and

lines.en: an abundance of rain. (And if it is in Virgo) it indicates war between the people of Iraq and the Turks, and the appearance of

lines.text: علوم و حکمت و فرح کتاب و وزراء و کثرت فوائد ایشان و بارندگی و فرح عامه و تعلق
lines.en: sciences and wisdom, and the joy of scribes and viziers, and the abundance of their benefits, and rain, and the joy of the common people, and attachment

lines.en: and the falling in love of women with men, and the making of talismans, and much laughter and joking among the creatures, and the appearance of

lines.text: مسخرگان و تغییر و نیکی احوال عمار و تجار و خوشحالی ارباب قلم و نزاع رومیان و
lines.en: jesters, and change, and the good condition of builders and merchants, and the happiness of the masters of the pen, and the dispute of the Romans and

lines.text: عراقیان اگر زهره مستعلی بود علم و حکمت ظاهر گردد و رعد و برق و باران و بسیار

lines.text: بازار و خبرها صحیح و نشاط در خلایق و میل مردم بلواطه و سحرها و افسونها و عما
lines.en: the bazaar, and true news, and joy among the creatures, and the inclination of people to sodomy, and magic, and incantations, and blindness

sections.en: The conjunction of Mercury and Venus

summary.headline: Mercury–Venus Conjunction in Earth Signs
summary.text: Astrological effects of the conjunction of Mercury and Venus in the earthy triplicity, Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn, including predictions of weather, crops, commerce, warfare, political fortunes, and social behavior. The text names Iraq, Armenia, Babylon, Fars, Rome, and the Turks, and discusses ascendance by Venus or Mercury.
